title: LCD Hub settings
description: %APPDATA%\LcdHub\settings.json. The tray menu writes most of it; restart the hub after editing by hand. Reference: https://github.com/stevehansen/LcdHub/blob/main/docs/settings.md

$schema.description: Lets your editor validate this file and explain each key. Rewritten on every save.

rotate_seconds.description: How long each app stays on a panel before the rotation moves on (tray: Rotate every).

app_seconds.description: Apps, by name, that stay on a panel for their own number of seconds instead of rotate_seconds (tray: Rotate every > app).

night_brightness.description: Percent the panels dim to between dusk and dawn, fading over the 40 minutes after sunset and before sunrise (tray: Dim at night). 100 is off.

today.description: What Today shows, the same on every panel (tray: Today).

weather_location.description: A place name for Open-Meteo to look up, e.g. "Antwerp". Without one there is no weather. Needs a restart.

date.description: Show the date under the time.

holidays.description: Show a holiday's name under the date, on the day.

sky.description: Sky colours for the time of day; off uses the style's background.

effects.description: Stars, the sun arc and the season's or holiday's particles.

style.description: The look every app is asked to draw in, so the rotation doesn't jar (tray: Appearance).

accent.description: "#RRGGBB". Without one, the Windows accent colour.

launch.description: Apps the hub starts with itself, restarts when they exit, and closes when it closes. Needs a restart.

path.description: The app's own exe (not dotnet run). Environment variables like %USERPROFILE% are expanded. An exe already running is left alone until it exits.

panels.description: Per panel, by id (e.g. "0416:5302"); written by the panel's tray menu.

today.description: Today takes its own turn in the rotation.

hidden.description: Apps, by name, left out of this panel's rotation.

pinned.description: An app, by name, kept on this panel instead of rotating; alerts still interrupt it.

video_path.description: A video playing on this panel instead of the rotation.
